**Coaching Note:**

Your opponent's king on h1 is trapped after Kh1. The knight on e4 can deliver a devastating fork with **Nf2+**, checking the king and attacking the queen and bishop simultaneously. After Kg1 (forced), capture Nxd3+ and you've won the bishop with check. Always look for knight forks when the enemy king is cornered—they're among the strongest tactical patterns.
